newsitem.title: UK: Storehouse up after 8.4 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Storehouse up after 8.4 mln shr placement.

text.p: Shares in UK retailer Storehouse rose amid talk that an 8.4 million share placement by NatWest was well received by the market, dealers and analysts said.
By 1246 GMT, Storehouse shares were up 8p to 260-1/2p on volume of 16.4 million.
"The shares have been placed, so there's no longer that overhang," said one analyst.
Storehouse shares had lost almost a third of their value since mid-April but had rebounded recently in the wake of better results and reports that company executives bought the stock.
Market makers said bid rumours also helped lift the shares but analysts played down the possibility.
"I'd be very surprised if Storehouse was the subject of a bid," said one. "I don't know why anyone would want to make a bid other than the fact that the stock is so cheap."
